title: tfc: no dreaming
description: tfc no dreaming is a fan made tfc 1.21 version due to tfc 1.21 is developing too slow
body:
tfc no dreaming is a fan made tfc 1.21 version due to tfc 1.21 is developing too slow, this mod isn't serious and it's low effort (tfc no dreaming, not tfc 1.21) and doesn't means to be rude, don't take it serious and have fun, this mod will be developed (not actively) until tfc 1.21

this mod adds new dimension (tfc dimension, so cool right?) new item and tools, you can create stone and blue steel tools for now, but i will add more later

but please, take a look at original tfc, this is a good mod
